————

小货车旁的李沐晴，脸上、手上所有伤口都不见了。

她的脸很白、很好看。

但眼角泛起微红，这是因为频繁擦眼泪导致的。

李沐晴双手交替握在身前，眼眶里不断涌出泪水，泪水顺着眼角两边滑落，然后在下巴尖交汇，再滴落。

她尽力扬起嘴角，想给屿哥看到自己最美的笑容，想让屿哥

可她看到屿哥骨折的手指、脸上的划伤、嘴角的鲜血时，眼泪就止不住地掉落。

李沐晴很想在离开前，再看看屿哥，可眼泪模糊了她的视野。

她着急地抬起左右手，用手背轻轻擦去泪水，这才继续笑着看向顾屿。

她微微歪头，风吹起她的发丝，吹起她的黑色短裤的裤脚，露出短裤下那笔直且白皙的双腿。

李沐晴的腿很美。

顾屿红着眼，看着站立起来的李沐晴，瞳孔疯狂抖动。

他嘴唇颤抖，缓缓挪步走向李沐晴。

他走得很慢，一直不敢相信这一幕。

他怕这只是幻觉，怕只自己在做梦。

无数次在梦里，顾屿都能看到李沐晴站了起来。

这一幕，他已经在梦里看过无数次了，也演练过无数次了。

可真的看到李沐晴站起来后，顾屿喉咙又酸又硬，就好像吞了一块石头。

顾屿缓缓走向李沐晴。

他就像个傻傻的孩子，不敢相信老爸真的买了那个，自己一直心心念的玩具。

李沐晴看着屿哥这副憨憨的模样，喜极而泣，扑哧一声笑了出来。

眼泪也随着笑声，从下巴尖抖落。

她向走到自己的面前的屿哥轻轻抬起右腿，试探性地问：

“屿哥...我腿...好看吗？”

李沐晴说出这句话时，害羞地低着头，iiO丫子的白皙脚趾头有些尴尬地卷了卷...

可她又鼓起勇气悄悄抬眸瞄向屿哥的表情，她怕屿哥不喜欢...

这一刻的顾屿，眼泪再也无法困住，直接从眼眶涌出。

他先是紧抿着嘴唇不让自己哭出声，又想张着嘴说出‘沐晴你真的很美’。

可又怕说话时，自己在沐晴面前哭出来，就赶紧抿起嘴唇，且越抿越紧。

于是顾屿就这么抿唇，滚动僵硬的喉咙，尝试张开嘴，又赶紧抿起嘴唇。

不断重复...

他很想说话，却被狂喜、自责、感动等情绪涌入大脑，让他说不出一句完整的话来：

“沐...这....好看...”

顾屿深呼吸好几口气，拍了拍自己的胸膛后，直接大喊出声：

“好看！”

Next to the pickup truck, all the wounds on Li Muqing's face and hands were gone.

Her face is very white and beautiful.

But the corners of his eyes were slightly red, which was caused by frequent wiping of tears.

Li Muqing held her hands in front of her alternately, tears constantly welling up in her eyes. The tears slid down both sides of the corners of her eyes, and then met at the tip of her chin before dripping again.

She tried her best to raise the corners of her mouth, wanting to show Brother Yu her most beautiful smile, and wanting Brother Yu to

But when she saw Brother Yu's broken fingers, scratches on his face, and blood at the corners of his mouth, her tears couldn't stop falling.

Li Muqing wanted to see Brother Yu again before leaving, but tears blurred her vision.

She anxiously raised her left and right hands and gently wiped away her tears with the back of her hands, then continued to look at Gu Yu with a smile.

She tilted her head slightly, and the wind blew her hair and the hems of her black shorts, revealing her straight and white legs under the shorts.

Li Muqing's legs are beautiful.

Gu Yu's eyes were red and he looked at Li Muqing who was standing up, his pupils shaking wildly.

His lips trembled and he slowly moved towards Li Muqing.

He walked very slowly, still unable to believe this scene.

He was afraid that this was just an illusion, that he was just dreaming.

Countless times in his dreams, Gu Yu could see Li Muqing standing up.

He has seen this scene countless times in his dreams and rehearsed it countless times.

But after seeing Li Muqing stand up, Gu Yu's throat felt sore and hard, as if he had swallowed a stone.

Gu Yu slowly walked towards Li Muqing.

He was like a silly child who couldn't believe that his father really bought that toy that he had always wanted.

Li Muqing looked at Brother Yu's innocent look, cried with joy, and burst into laughter.

Tears also shook from the tip of his chin with laughter.

She gently raised her right leg towards Brother Yu who was walking in front of her, and asked tentatively:

"Brother Yu...do my legs...look good?"

When Li Muqing said this, she lowered her head shyly, and iiO Yazi's white toes curled up in embarrassment...

But she mustered up the courage to quietly raise her eyes to look at Brother Yu's expression. She was afraid that Brother Yu wouldn't like it...

At this moment, Gu Yu's tears could no longer be trapped and poured out directly from his eyes.

First he pressed his lips tightly to prevent himself from crying, then he opened his mouth and wanted to say, 'Mu Qing, you are really beautiful.'

But she was afraid that she would cry in front of Mu Qing when she spoke, so she quickly pursed her lips together and pursed her lips tighter and tighter.

So Gu Yu just pursed his lips, rolled his stiff throat, tried to open his mouth, and then quickly pursed his lips.

Keep repeating...

He wanted to speak, but emotions such as ecstasy, self-blame, and emotion flooded into his brain, making it impossible for him to say a complete sentence:

"Mu...this...is beautiful..."

Gu Yu took several deep breaths, patted his chest, and shouted:

"Good looking!"
